_meta.description: Per-body section overrides (data/sections.json) where the kind-based default is wrong for a body in a regime, or to give in_curia to a body the constitution leaves 'not-listed'. One entry per (body, regime); it applies to the body's whole span within that regime.
_meta.in_curia: For a listed section, in_curia repeats the section's own value. For 'not-listed', true/false only where the research curia_status or an act states it; null = the override fixes the section only, and the seeder still adds the gap note.
_meta.not_done: The design §6.3 example (Penitentiary and Rota 'in the Curia' although Immensa omits them) is not encoded: the research curia_status gives no statement for that period.
